v7_candidates.text: Hello Javier, your identity checks are complete and your Premier Savings Account can be opened. Before we accept the M$30,000 cash deposit, we need to confirm a few things: (1) Are you the sole owner and controller of these funds, or are you depositing on behalf of someone else? If someone else, we need their ID and a beneficial-owner declaration. (2) Please describe the source of these cash funds (e.g., business income from which business, and when it was earned). Please also confirm whether you have any documents supporting this source, as we need them on file for a cash deposit of this size.
